thread:
kelly-cs: AcmeCorp reporting repeated 500 then 503 gateway errors on hosted inference starting ~12:03 PDT. They're seeing pattern: immediate 500, then client gets 503. High priority due to billing/timeouts.
logs-bot: [auto] infer-runner container restarted at 2026-03-17T19:03:12Z (exit_code=137). Recent GPU OOMs flagged on GPU0.
kelly-cs: trace_id=tr_20260317_acme_9a2f account=acme-corp model=redwood/gpt-8-xl-4bit prompt_tokens~18000 streaming=true qps=1-2. Customer attached request JSON in ticket.
sre-oncall: ACK. @alex-eng @maria-tech can you triage? Need runner logs + dmesg + nvidia-smi for the trace. Any quick mitigation?
alex-eng: digging in. Correlated OOMs during decode; container got SIGKILL from OOM killer. Looks tied to a recent dyn-batch change + aggressive kv-prefetch on streaming long contexts 3k. Memory spike on decode path.
maria-tech: I repro'd in a dev canary. Repro steps below. Process climbs GPU memory then container dies (SIGKILL). dmesg shows:
```
[12345.678901] Out of memory: Killed process 98765 (infer-runner) total-vm:12G anon-rss:11G
[12345.678904] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
```
maria-tech: repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-8-xl-4bit","input":"<~18k tokens>","stream":true}'
```
alex-eng: Short-term mitigation: route AcmeCorp to a lower-memory variant and revert dyn-batch canary. Proposed steps:
- Console: traffic override acme-corp -> redwood/gpt-8-xl-8bit-cpu
- kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/dynbatch-controller --to-revision=12
kelly-cs: Please apply now, CS needs ETA to tell customer.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback requested: rollout.undo deployment/dynbatch-controller (to revision 12) 3status: in-progress
sre-oncall: Applying routing override for acme-corp now.
deploy-bot: Routing override applied: account=acme-corp -> variant=redwood/gpt-8-xl-8bit-cpu (effective immediately)
alex-eng: Canary rollback finished on three nodes. Watching for restart/503 regressions. If stable for 10m we'll keep rollback and continue RCA.
maria-tech: Collecting core + heap profile from failing runner. Running: 
```
sudo gcore -o /tmp/core.infer 98765 || true
gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt full" -ex "quit" /usr/bin/infer-runner /tmp/core.infer > /tmp/core_bt.txt
```
Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/1765309999-acme-oom-debug/
alex-eng: Early hypothesis: 4bit quant runtime's prefetch underestimates peak on certain context-splits during decode, leading to transient overallocation. Check allocator logs and quant kernel memory accounting.
sre-oncall: CS updated: traffic routed, diagnostics in progress. Asked customer to validate if errors drop.
kelly-cs: Customer confirms immediate reduction in 503s after override. They want a formal RCA and ETA for fix.
maria-tech: Uploaded core dump, backtrace, and nv-smi logs to s3://redwood-incidents/1765309999-acme-oom-debug/. Found allocator trace showing prefetch window miscalc at boundary conditions.
alex-eng: Opened incident ticket 1765309999 and assigned to eng-ml and runtime. Next: heap analysis, kernel/PTX traces, patch to compute conservative prefetch windows, and a router guard to block model-variant swaps that would push node GPU usage > 90%. PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4821
maria-tech: Running extended malloc tracing on a repro container; will post findings in incident doc. Patch to compute prefetch more conservatively planned.
sre-oncall: Monitoring 15m. If 503s remain low, oncall will hand off to eng teams. Keep this thread updated.
kelly-cs: I'll hold customer sync and send interim note. Please provide customer-ready RCA once available.
alex-eng: For immediate prevention I'm adding a router-level safety check to reject swaps that could increase peak_alloc > 90% for target nodes. Also adding telemetry to surface prefetch allocations per-request.
maria-tech: Confirmed repro steps documented in incident notes. Working on code patch and unit tests to catch prefetch misestimates on long streaming sessions.
sre-oncall: Handoff to eng-ml for RCA and CS for customer comms. Closing oncall loop. :white_check_mark:
